how_chosen: Constructed the specified smoothed histograms and minimized mean training cross-entropy using analytic-gradient SLSQP from 50 initializations (uniform, all vertices, and random simplex points), then refined the active weights by solving the KKT equations. The final mean training cross-entropy is 1.517844472226377 nats; active stationarity and inactive inequalities verify global optimality for this convex simplex objective to numerical precision. Uniform weighting (CE 1.993950944313) and the best single component (train_marginal, CE 1.752161682296) did not improve the optimized mixture.
